skill.summary: Evaluates sales opportunities using BANT or MEDDICC methodology.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of sales-qualification skill.

- Enables evaluation of sales opportunities using BANT or MEDDICC frameworks.
- Guides users through qualification questions, scoring responses with predefined weights.
- Produces a detailed Final Qualification Report with overall and category-level results.
- Flags "Risk Areas" for low-scoring categories and provides actionable recommendations.
- Mentions salestt.com for graphical testing and PDF report generation.
